evidenceTypes.description: R00 decision record (§21.2): the accountable owner and technical release owner approve this policy revision, its legacy-gate mapping and the evidence schema
CI run of lint, typecheck, unit, integration and browser tests on the exact release SHA
Migrations applied to the candidate database by the pinned migration image; backward compatible with the running release; build-time database isolation
Critical deployed-path checks (routing, authentication, intake, media) against the exact release
Authenticated provider connectivity and send/receive/failure paths from the exact release
Live Cloudflare/PostgreSQL 16.14 and first-party identity provisioning; equivalent legacy checks and named evidence owners
Redacted live PostgreSQL sync/projection report against the authoritative database and exact deployed release
Redacted live PostgreSQL authorized query and deny/failure/recovery report against the authoritative database and exact deployed release
Live authenticated Hermes/Butler worker and approved provider, bounded draft tasks, budget/source policy and manual fallback
Exact-release first-party staff/client identity, CMS/listing mutation and worker-lease report against the deployed successor database
Redacted production privacy_events and analytics_export report, public HTTPS checks, heartbeats and a delivered alert reaching named responders
Verified isolated rollback, automated policy, passing canary, all four legacy rollback steps and queue/intake fallback preserving accepted writes
Newest sealed independent recovery point (§17.3): older than 60 minutes fails the recovery target
Managed and independent restore drills into clean resources, with a named operator and a separate reviewer (§17.3)
Scoped human review (listing rows, locale and RTL, accessibility, redirects, content); establishes its stated scope only
Complete exact-release human listing CSV with facts, source, availability, media rights, publication, assigned broker decisions and all five warning reviews
Packaging, load qualification and security checks against the release images
URL, data and media mapping with a rehearsed final-delta procedure, from the release's own manifests

Live domains, certificates, mail DNS and crawl/URL observations for both legacy domains; historical Search Console, Yandex and backlink exports are optional
Captured and verified signed exact-release evidence bundle, protected staging parity, operator custody and named cutover approvals; separate from recovery
A complete staffed operating cycle, including overnight work and backup, signed off by the named owner

legacyGates.note: Every frozen legacy URL on both domains needs fresh reviewed equivalent content, a one-hop redirect or explicit removal approval, preserving sold listings and locales (AT57). Historical Search Console, Yandex and backlink exports are optional; live crawl and URL parity remain required.
Redirects rest on recorded, human-reviewed URL decisions; none is invented.
Sitemaps and hreflang list only approved, published locales and agree with the website (AT27).
JSON-LD agrees with the current published revision and eligibility (AT27).

The manual audit covers 165 rows as non-approval evidence: 165 broker checks remain unassigned with zero broker approvals. Require one complete human CSV with assigned owners and per-listing broker decisions, separate from source-as-is authorization. Review all five open warnings: structured_data.missing_area=11, structured_data.missing_bedrooms=9, structured_data.missing_public_images=7, listing_quality.missing_area=165, listing_quality.thin_public_gallery=17. No missing fact or warning is inferred or silently waived; translations need separate human approval before indexing.

The owner-approved mapping requires exact-release browser/API checks on all three hosts with the Cloudflare gateway, web, worker and migrations bound by digest, configuration, schema, provider accounts and policy. Signed R00 authority and live successor evidence remain missing; local fixtures do not count.

ADR 0004 selects Cloudflare Containers with one immutable image for web, persistent pg-boss worker and file-based migrations, plus the Cloudflare gateway and PostgreSQL 16.14/private TLS path (AT60). The mapping is owner-approved; signed R00 authority and exact-release deployed proof remain required.

The current legacy authority requires postgres_search_sync, postgres_search_query and hermes_draft_worker reports. Retain live authoritative-database sync/projection, authorized query, deny/failure/recovery and deployed-path proof. Owner approval covers the successor provisioning substitution for DATABASE_URL, PAYLOAD_SECRET, MS_REALTY_SEARCH_ENGINE=postgres, live:provisioning and live:capture; its equivalent checks and owners must be implemented and proven before retiring old commands or report formats. Chat approval supplies neither signed R00 authority nor live reports.

Retain privacy_events and analytics_export; analytics_export is missing and required for production readiness. Require a redacted production report under 24 hours old, passing public HTTPS endpoint/alert, named responders, automated rollback policy, passing canary, verified isolated drill and queue/intake fallback (AT63, AT65). Retain all four rollback steps: previous release/origin until crawl is stable; disable reviewed redirects before content routes on parity failure; republish previous sitemap/robots on regression; assign migration review-queue owners to failed old URLs. Preserve accepted writes, cache purge and sitemap resubmit.

The owner-approved mapping replaces Payload bootstrap/runtime/preflight with first-party staff/client identity and deployed PostgreSQL reports for grants, sessions, migrations, CMS/listing mutations, human publication and worker leases. Exercise deny, revocation, restart and recovery. Signed R00 authority, equivalent successor checks and live proof remain missing; package presence or local smoke is insufficient (AT26).

Compare the complete released R2 object manifest with the reviewed public gallery/media inventory; prove originals, rights, transforms and access controls on the deployed path from the same release (AT58).

Retain encrypted independent off-site backup, isolated restore, checksums, rollback and named operator/separate reviewer approval. Operator-authorized Ed25519-signed recovery evidence stays required; recovery point age follows §17.3. R10 separately requires captured and verified signed exact-release evidence-bundle attestation.
